name: ner_llama_conll
description: LLaMA-3.1-8B fine-tuned on CoNLL-2003 NER, N=8, T=1.0. Cross-model validation for model-agnostic claim.
analysis:
Reviewer argument: 'Two 8B decoder-only models trained with identical LoRA rank on the same data showing similar behavior is not model-agnostic validation — it's confirmation that your experimental setup is internally consistent, which we already assumed. Show me an encoder model, a 70B model, or an API-only model without logprob access.' This neutralizes R2/R14 mitigation entirely. The high CoNLL degeneracy (56%) makes the cross-model comparison on selection MOOT — there's nothing to select from regardless of model.

LLaMA-3.1-8B 在 CoNLL 上表现与 Qwen3-8B 高度一致（SJ ρ≈0.43 vs Qwen 0.436），这在 worst 档被 reviewer 解读为：同体量 decoder-only 模型 + 同 LoRA recipe → 相似行为是 trivially expected，不构成 'model-agnostic' 证据。Reviewer 会要求 encoder-based (DeBERTa) 或 70B+ 规模模型。AUROC 0.70-0.76 被认为是 majority-vote 在高 F1 数据集上的 trivial baseline 表现。CoNLL 高 degeneracy (56%) 使 selection headroom 仅 2pp，selection 结果 indistinguishable from greedy，进一步佐证 reviewer 的 'predictable for fine-tuned models' 评价。

name: simple_verifier_baseline
description: Logistic regression on 5 unsupervised signals (SJ, FK, EM, VC, LP) as supervised verifier. Train on existing (input, output, F1) triplets. 5-fold CV on SciERC.

tables.name: Table: Supervised Verifier vs Unsupervised Signals (SciERC NER, 5-fold CV)

analysis:
Worst-tier reviewer response: 'The supervised verifier closes 3% of the oracle gap using the same signals that individually close <5%. This is expected — linear combinations of correlated weak signals yield a correlated weak signal. The real question is whether a verifier with access to input representations (not just output statistics) can close the gap. You haven't tested this, and your 'path forward' remains speculative.' The result actively HURTS the paper because it demonstrates the 5 signals collectively contain negligible selection-relevant information beyond what any single signal provides. This undercuts Contribution B's 'constructive implications' framing — there's no evidence the gap IS closable.

在 worst 档，A5 的核心假设是 'path forward is entirely speculative'。即使 exp-019 完成（实际已被 killed），logistic regression 仅做 5 signal 的线性组合 — 与 exp-016 的 ensemble 本质相同。exp-016 已显示 ensemble AUROC (0.666) < best single EM (0.749)，因为 5 信号高度相关 (SJ-LP Pearson=0.57, SJ-VC 更高)。LR 在高相关特征上 overfit 导致 CV variance 大、泛化差。关键问题：LR 只能做信号的加权组合，不能学到 instance-level nonlinear interaction — 而 oracle gap 的信息恰恰存在于这些 interaction 中。Reviewer 判定：'A logistic regression on the same 5 signals you already showed don't work individually is not a trained verifier — it's a weighted average. A real verifier would use the input text, predicted output, and intermediate representations. This doesn't address the gap.'  oracle_gap_closure 3.2% 落在 worst 档 [0,5] 范围内。

name: claim_audit
description: Systematic cross-chapter numerical consistency audit. Check all quantitative claims against source data. Resolve known contradictions.

critical_issues: Abstract claims AUROC 0.82 but max observed is 0.749 (EM NER) from 1024-token data; 0.82 only achievable with EM on CoNLL which has 58% degeneracy
Discussion '+0.2pp over greedy' uses Table 2 macro but intro cites sample-level delta
Capability trap R²=0.94 on n=3 still referenced in Conclusion despite downgrade to 'qualitative'
results.greedy_f1_inconsistency: 3 different greedy F1 values cited for SciERC NER (0.618, 0.644, 0.667) from different max_tokens/seeds

analysis:
Worst-tier impact: 审计本身不产生新证据，但暴露的不一致被 reviewer 用作 'insufficient care in reporting' 的证据。关键问题是 AUROC 0.82 — 这是论文最显眼的数字（Abstract 第一句），但无法用单一实验直接支撑。如果 0.82 来自 CoNLL EM AUROC 0.84，reviewer 会指出 CoNLL 58% degeneracy 使该数字 misleading（模型已 saturated，高 AUROC 只是在区分'全对' vs '差一两个 entity'）。如果来自 voting_conf 在某个 seed 的 AUROC，则不 reproducible。Worst-tier reviewer 会写：'The authors claim AUROC 0.82 in the abstract but I cannot find this exact number in any table. The closest is 0.749 (Table 3, SciERC EM) or 0.816 (Table 4, CoNLL EM). This kind of discrepancy undermines confidence in the reported results.' Soundness score: 3 (low end of worst range).

在 worst 档下，claim audit 暴露出论文内部数值混乱的根本原因：实验跨越多个月、多次 rerun (512→1024 token, gold-empty filtering pipeline change, 3 seeds)，导致同一指标在不同章节引用不同来源。Abstract 的 AUROC 0.82 来自 paper_framing 的 Claim 1 描述 ('AUROC up to 0.82')，但实际最高值是 CoNLL EM AUROC 0.8156 (exp_002 registry) 或 SciERC EM AUROC 0.749 (exp_012_rerun_1024)。0.82 可能是 exp_002_conll_n16 的 EM AUROC 0.8409 四舍五入后的 legacy 值，但该数据集 degeneracy 58%。Reviewer 注意到数值不一致时会扣 soundness 分 — 从 4 降到 3。3 个未解决矛盾会被标注为 'careless writing' 或 'claims not fully supported by evidence'，直接影响 reviewer confidence。这不影响科学结论但影响 accept probability — worst 档 reviewer 已经倾向 reject，数值不一致提供了具体依据。
